answer: Pay rewards on a vesting ledge: each epoch's earnings unlock only after an identity keeps answering, unaided, for eight more epochs, and one missed or copied answer resets its clock. To forge a hundred puppets, an attacker must keep a hundred distinct voices alive for two days, each with its own quill, while peer graders compare style fingerprints. The compute bill grows with every clone, yet the payout stays locked until the fleet has had many chances to be caught.
